description: Harness-neutral discovery catalog for Education AI Suite workflow skills. Paths are relative to the repository root (education-ai-suite/). 'apps' lists the apps a skill covers.

skills.name: edu-install
skills.description: Install the full Education AI Suite or one app (Smart Classroom on Windows or Linux, AI Teaching Assistant, Flutter RAG demo, OpenClaw demo): check prerequisites, get the folders, run setup with agent-friendly flags, and hand off to edu-run.
requires: Windows 11 or Ubuntu 24.04, depending on the app

skills.name: edu-run
skills.description: Start, stop, health-check, and open any suite app or user app; reports which services are up and offers to open the app in the default browser.

skills.name: edu-build-app
skills.description: Build a new app in user-apps/<name>/ on top of the suite's running services. Plans first with an ASCII pipeline diagram and an Intel runtime and device table, then generates, verifies, runs, and offers to open it.
triggers: new app that uses smart classroom
requires: the suite services the app uses are installed

skills.name: edu-frontend
skills.description: Change the UI of an existing app (Smart Classroom React/Electron UI, Smart Classroom Linux UI, AI Teaching Assistant React UI, Flutter RAG demo), keeping API wiring and translations consistent, then build, lint, and offer to open it.
requires: Node.js for the React UIs, or the Flutter SDK for the Flutter demo

skills.name: edu-configure
skills.description: Enable or disable features, switch models, or move a stage to OpenVINO or between CPU, GPU, and NPU in an existing app; shows the before/after pipeline, applies the config, restarts the right services, and verifies.

skills.name: edu-perf
skills.description: Measure per-stage latency (p50/p95), CPU/GPU/NPU/memory utilization, power, and actual model devices for Smart Classroom and the AI Teaching Assistant, and report comparable results.

skills.name: sc-setup
skills.description: Set up Flutter integration with Content Search backend and VLM service. Creates main backend venv (includes VLM dependencies) and content search venv, installs all requirements, validates config.yaml, and prepares Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct model.

skills.name: sc-up
skills.description: Start main backend with VLM service (port 8000), auto-start Content Search backend (port 9011), and launch Flutter app. VLM model (Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct) loads on startup (2-3 minutes). Validates service health before launching UI.

skills.name: sc-doctor
skills.description: Check Content Search backend health by probing the health endpoint and diagnosing Flutter-to-backend connectivity issues.

skills.name: sc-upload
skills.description: Upload a file to the Content Search backend and poll the ingestion task until indexed (COMPLETED). Handles duplicate detection, cleanup, and retry. Works with PDFs, videos, images, and Office documents.
requires: healthy Content Search backend (run sc-doctor first)
a supported file: pdf, txt, docx, pptx, xlsx, jpg, jpeg, png, mp4, avi, mov, mkv

skills.name: sc-qa
skills.description: Ask questions against indexed content via RAG Q&A endpoint powered by VLM (Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct). Content Search retrieves relevant chunks, VLM generates grounded answers with cited sources. Supports multi-turn history, tag filtering. Answer generation takes 30-90 seconds.
requires: at least one COMPLETED ingestion (run sc-upload first)

skills.name: sc-files
skills.description: List, inspect, filter, and delete files that have been indexed in the Content Search backend. Also lists available tags.
